name: jewelry-erp
description: Jewelry ERP — orchestrator scripts. Backend lives in ./backend, frontend in ./frontend.

scripts.init: npm run setup && npm run db:up && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.setup: npm run setup:env && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python -m venv .venv && node ../scripts/python.js -m pip install --upgrade pip && node ../scripts/python.js -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it jewelry_erp_postgres psql -U jewelry -d jewelry_erp
